menu.item: Paluto cooking fee (per kg, as reported by diners)

menu.source: common paluto option, no verified price

menu_source_note: Raw seafood prices per kilo change daily and I found no verified 2026 prices. Ask for the per-kg price and the cooking fee before buying or weighing. Cash only
service_charge: Some paluto eateries may add rice/drinks/service. Confirm before ordering
fair_vs_pricey: Settle the per-kg price and cooking fee before weighing. Tourists are sometimes quoted higher prices (reviews). Lobster and lapu-lapu are the expensive picks; shrimp, squid and fish are better value
group_of_7_notes: Best 'experience' meal for a group of 7: pick seafood together, then a paluto eatery seats you at a long table. Go at lunch to avoid crowds
